# Repository About metadata

Suggested GitHub About settings, prepared for the repository owner. This file does not automatically change GitHub settings.

**Description**

TypeScript data grid with a headless core, Canvas rendering, React/Vue adapters, rich text, permissions and spreadsheet interactions.

**Topics**

`typescript`, `data-grid`, `canvas`, `spreadsheet`, `react`, `vue`, `headless`, `rich-text`, `mcp`, `mit-license`

**Website**

Project website: [Acheron Grid](https://acheron-grid.haoduong.dev/). Author website: [Hao Duong](https://haoduong.dev/).

**Status**

The original six packages are npm 0.1.0 development previews. Export/charts and Unreleased changes are source previews. Do not describe this repository as a stable release or enterprise support offering.
